independent_gates: Schema, binding, numeric encoding, input mathematics, expression semantics, solution, boundaries and composition retain separate gates. Provenance can pass while an incorrect scalar claim causes semantics/solution failure. Strict acceptance additionally requires provenance true.
limits: Exact supported canonical trees, not general symbolic equivalence
Proves represented source references, not model internal reasoning or external dataset truth
No academic approval, publication permission, renderer readiness, production readiness or live model qualification
source_resolution: expressions.context_for independently recomputes Fraction values from proposed_math_inputs using authored_math.summary_stats. provenance.DEPENDENCIES binds names to those inputs and independently derived terms; proposed_solution scalar values are never binding authority.

status_conditions.FAILED: Any evaluated field has wrong source identity, wrong operation structure, swapped operands, self-reference, unsupported/malformed expression, or a literal under current policy. FAILED dominates aggregate results.
status_conditions.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Explicit historical replay encounters literal operands whose source identities cannot be established; valid is null. No earlier self-reference violation may be present, and no failed field may dominate the aggregate. All 40 historical fields have this status.
status_conditions.NOT_EVALUATED: No verifier result exists: schema/encoding/input computation prevented reaching the stage, explicit legacy policy bypasses that stage, or old records have absent fields. valid remains null; absence is never converted to FAILED or PASSED.
status_conditions.PASSED: All four parsed canonical trees exactly match their application-owned role templates, without self references or literal operands. Symbol names and operation structure must match. Numeric values never decide this outcome.
